name: Hotel Achentalerhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Achentalerhof in Achenkirch is located directly on the shore of Lake Achensee. The wellness area includes a Finnish sauna, a steam bath, and a relaxation room with lake views. The restaurant serves regional Tiroler specialties and international dishes. The rooms are spacious and equipped with modern furniture; many have a balcony. The surrounding area offers hiking, cycling, and water sports. Lake Achensee is also ideal for boat trips and swimming.
